name: alertmanager_query
description: Query and manage Prometheus Alertmanager alerts and silences via the Alertmanager HTTP API v2. Supports listing active/silenced/inhibited alerts with label-based filtering, viewing alert groups, creating and expiring silences for alert tuning, and checking Alertmanager cluster status.

parameters.name: --filter
parameters.description: Alert matcher expression(s), comma-separated. Syntax: alertname="MyAlert", severity=~"critical|warning", instance!="localhost". Used with list_alerts and list_alert_groups.

parameters.name: --active
parameters.description: Include active (firing) alerts. Default: true. Use --no-active to exclude.

parameters.name: --silenced
parameters.description: Include silenced alerts. Default: true. Use --no-silenced to exclude.

parameters.name: --inhibited
parameters.description: Include inhibited alerts. Default: true. Use --no-inhibited to exclude.

parameters.name: --receiver
parameters.description: Filter by receiver name (regex match). Used with list_alerts.

parameters.name: --silence_id
parameters.description: Silence UUID. Required for get_silence and expire_silence.

parameters.name: --matchers
parameters.description: JSON array of matcher objects for create_silence. Each matcher: {"name": "label", "value": "val", "isRegex": false, "isEqual": true}. Required for create_silence.

parameters.name: --starts_at
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime for silence start. Defaults to now. Used with create_silence.

parameters.name: --ends_at
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime for silence end. Required for create_silence.

parameters.name: --created_by
parameters.description: Author of the silence. Used with create_silence.

parameters.name: --comment
parameters.description: Reason for creating the silence. Required for create_silence.

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Max results to return (client-side limit since Alertmanager has no server-side pagination).

parameters.name: --alertmanager_url
parameters.description: Alertmanager base URL. Overrides ALERTMANAGER_URL env var.

parameters.name: --dry_run
parameters.description: Validate the request without executing. Returns what would happen.

returns: JSON object with fields: {"ok": bool, "count": int, "data": array|object, "message": string}. For list operations, data is an array of alert or silence objects. For create_silence, data contains the silence ID.
examples: alertmanager_query create_silence --matchers "[{"name": "alertname", "value": "NonActionableAlert", "isRegex": false, "isEqual": true}]" --ends_at 2026-04-24T10:00:00Z --comment "Non-actionable alert — no incidents in 30+ days" --created_by ai-sre
